scripts.qa: bash -lc "NODE_ENV=production npm run build && NODE_ENV=production npm run start"
scripts.prod: bash -lc "NODE_ENV=production npm run build && NODE_ENV=production npm run start:built"
scripts.start:built: node -e "const m=require('./build/manifest.json'); if(!m.builtFile) { console.error('No build found. Run: npm run build'); process.exit(1);} require('child_process').spawn(process.execPath,[m.builtFile],{stdio:'inherit'});"
